Loona Code

Hi Guys,

Loona is still young — but we've already done things that teams twice our size struggle to pull off. I'm proud of that. And I hope you've had fun while doing it, too.

I'm all for the fun, the jokes, and the freedom — but only when the work is done, and done right. That's the deal.

As we grow, each of us has a chance to shape not just Loona but our own professional journeys. That means thinking beyond tasks — and asking: How can I contribute to where we're going next?

These rules aren't meant to limit anyone — they're here to give us structure, so we can scale without losing our edge. So take them seriously. Make them yours.

We're building something real here.

So, let's keep building something we're all proud of!!!!!

— Gokul

At Loona, the one thing we protect the most is the culture we have built together.

We are one team, one Loonatic family — different minds, different roles, different phases, each of us simply a different shade of the same moon. No one here is above or below anyone.

Everything Loona is today has been shaped by the effort, hard work, and heart of everyone who has been part of this journey.

We do not believe in hierarchy as a measure of worth. The org chart below is only a representation of work structure, responsibilities, and flow — not importance.

Org Chart
These policies are the framework this studio operates within — not guidelines. Full compliance is expected from everyone, without exception. If anything here is unclear, raise it with management directly — not with each other.

Every employee gets 15 days of paid leave a year (over and above public holidays), accrued pro-rata at 1.25 days/month from the start of the financial year (April) or your joining date, whichever is later.

Sick leave is not tracked as a separate category — it's merged into this same annual entitlement, same as most organisations.

A medical certificate is mandatory for any sick leave, especially when taken on a Saturday, Monday, or around a bank holiday. Sick leave on these days without a valid certificate will be automatically adjusted against paid or unpaid leave, and repeated misuse will result in disciplinary action.

An unapproved absence (no punch, not pre-approved) is deducted from your leave balance as Official Leave. If you did punch in but worked unusually short hours, it's fined instead — see Attendance & Fines.

Working days are Monday–Saturday. Business hours are 10:00 am–5:30 pm (10:00 am–3:30 pm on Saturdays), with one designated weekly off. You may occasionally be asked to work on holidays based on project deadlines or business needs, at management's discretion.

Late arrivals, half days, and short-hours absences are fined at ₹200 for every 3 occurrences.

A formal warning on late arrivals has already been issued to the team — this is the final notice. Attendance is being monitored closely, and continued violations will be escalated.

WFH is not, and has never been, a standard policy at Loona. No WFH request will be entertained unless there is a genuine emergency, and even then it must be approved in advance by your Reporting Manager. Same-day requests will not be considered.

You are expected to maintain professionalism and represent Loona positively at all shoots, events, and client interactions. Misconduct or inappropriate behaviour with clients or team members may result in immediate termination.

Timely presence, adherence to schedules, and meeting delivery deadlines are essential to every role — repeated delays or absenteeism may be treated as misconduct.

4.aTeam Communication Rules

Applies to all internal work communication — primarily WhatsApp, plus email and the Hub.

  • Every work-related message must be replied to properly — no emoji-only responses. ✅ "Working on SC deck, will send by 3 PM."   ❌ "👌", "Yesss"
  • No ghosting, no floating deliverables — every message needs a clear, actionable response.
  • If you have doubts, pick up the phone and call your lead. Don't wait around or delay the task — work cannot be paused just because you're unsure.
  • Ask questions, clarify quickly, and summarise if needed.
  • Acknowledge any new task or feedback within 1 working hour.
4.bFeedback & Revisions
  • Feedback loops are a normal part of the process — don't take them personally.
  • Always implement changes after confirming you've understood them. If unclear, ask immediately.
  • Keep it efficient: max 2 rounds of internal review before sharing with the client.
  • Revisions are to uphold Loona's quality standards, not to nitpick.
4.cResponsibility & Ownership
  • If you're assigned a task, you own it until it's done, approved, and shared — no hand-offs without context.
  • Don't wait to be reminded. Reminders are not a workflow.
  • If you're blocked or delayed, communicate early — not when the deadline passes.
4.dExternal Communication Etiquette
  • Always use a professional tone and structure in all client-facing communication — email, DMs, or WhatsApp.
  • Never share incomplete work without internal approval or context.
  • Decks, visuals, or pitch work should always be shared as PDFs, unless the client asks for editable versions.
  • Every email must include a subject — it reflects clarity, respect, and urgency.

Punctuality — whether it's being present at work or completing tasks on time — is of utmost importance at Loona. We have an internal performance analysis system that monitors your performance with a monthly score based on various factors, all built into the Hub.

This performance score will be one of the biggest criteria for your future at Loona, including appraisals and promotions. Please make sure your score doesn't fall below 90%.

Your score is reviewed on an ongoing basis, and failing to maintain it can lead to disciplinary action, including termination from your position.

What is confidential information?

"Confidential Information" includes, but is not limited to:

  • All client information, briefs, strategies, and internal communications.
  • Campaign ideas, storyboards, scripts, shoot plans, and creative concepts.
  • Canva decks, strategy decks, internal presentations, images, raw footage, edited videos, photography, design files, and any other creative assets.
  • Client and influencer contact details, vendor lists, and collaboration databases.
  • Any financial, operational, or business data of the Company or its clients.
  • Any other material, tangible or intangible, produced, shared, or accessed during employment.

The Employee agrees and understands that:

  • All work produced, shared, or accessed during employment is confidential and proprietary.
  • Such materials must not be shown, shared, distributed, forwarded, or uploaded anywhere, including but not limited to personal portfolios, résumés, websites, social media, or third-party platforms.
  • No visuals, decks, client/influencer data, raw or edited footage, or campaign concepts may be used or presented as personal work at any time.
  • All work at Loona is a collaborative effort of the team, and no individual may claim independent authorship, credit, or representation without prior written consent from management.
  • All materials, files, and data (digital or physical) must be returned or deleted immediately upon termination of employment or upon management's request.

You agree that for a period of twelve (12) months following the termination of your employment with Loona, you shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business, project, or freelance work with any client or partner of Loona that you have interacted with, worked on, or had access to during your tenure, without prior written consent from management. This restriction applies to both paid and unpaid engagements and is intended to protect the company's business interests and client relationships.

You agree not to solicit or attempt to solicit Loona employees, freelancers, or clients for personal or competitive projects, during or after your employment, for a period of twelve (12) months.

All content, visuals, designs, videos, photographs, edits, strategies, and concepts created during employment shall be considered "work made for hire" and remain the exclusive intellectual property of Loona and/or its clients. The Employee shall have no ownership, usage, or distribution rights whatsoever.

The confidentiality and non-disclosure obligations of the Employee shall remain in effect indefinitely, even after cessation of employment.

Any breach of this Agreement — including the unauthorised sharing, use, or representation of the Company's work, materials, or contacts — shall constitute serious misconduct and a violation of trust. Such a breach may result in immediate termination of employment, and the Company reserves the right to seek legal remedies, including injunctive relief, recovery of damages, and criminal prosecution under applicable laws of India.

Loonarae Studio Private Limited operates under the laws of the State of Maharashtra, India. All employees are expected to comply with the Company's policies relating to confidentiality, intellectual property, client information, company assets, and professional conduct.

Any unauthorised disclosure, misuse, copying, retention, distribution, theft, or reproduction of confidential information, client data, creative work, source files, strategies, passwords, financial records, or any proprietary material belonging to Loonarae Studio Private Limited may result in disciplinary action, immediate termination of employment, and legal proceedings.

Where applicable, legal action may be initiated under the Indian Contract Act, 1872, the Copyright Act, 1957, the Information Technology Act, 2000, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, and any other applicable laws in force for the protection of the Company's rights, confidential information, and intellectual property.

Any dispute or legal proceeding relating to employment or Company matters shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Maharashtra, India.

During probation: you may resign by giving one (1) month's notice, or salary/wages in lieu. The Company may terminate your employment during probation without any notice or compensation in cases of misconduct, breach of policy, negligence, or failure to perform assigned duties.

After confirmation: you may resign by giving two (2) months' notice, or surrendering salary/wages in lieu. The Company may terminate by giving one (1) month's notice, or salary/wages in lieu thereof. The Company reserves the right to terminate without any notice, indemnity, or compensation in cases of misconduct, breach of policy, negligence, or failure to perform assigned duties.

Your appointment is subject to your being declared medically fit by a Registered Medical Practitioner.

Your services will be governed by any Rules and Regulations enforced by the management from time to time in relation to conduct, discipline, medical leave and holidays, or any other matters relating to service conditions, which will be deemed as rules and regulations and form part of these terms of employment.

As a term of employment, you will not misuse your position by disclosing or divulging to any person the knowledge or confidential information concerning the organisation or its clients in whatever form acquired by you while in the employment of the organisation. Towards this, you may be called upon to execute a non-disclosure agreement with the organisation.

This offer is subject to your signing the prescribed (i) Secrecy and non-disclosure agreement, and (ii) an agreement as to patents, inventions, and other creative property rights and competitive activities, as per the organisation's policies and practices at the time of joining, and as amended from time to time by management.

Whenever you change your present or local residential address for any reason, you must intimate the change to management immediately. Working hours are as communicated by your superiors from time to time, depending on the exigencies of work. Management reserves the right to restructure or change your compensation at any time, at its sole discretion.

Your appointment is based on the information supplied by you. If you're found to have misrepresented, concealed, or given wrong information about your candidature at the time of appointment or subsequently, your services shall be liable for termination without any notice or compensation.

This Employee Reimbursement Form is to be used for all conveyance, local purchase, and food bill claims. Please ensure every claim submitted is genuine and made in good faith, using the most economical resources available to keep costs reasonable.

🚕
Conveyance mode of preference: always use auto or train first — cab services like Uber, Ola, or Rapido should only be used in exceptional situations.
🍽️
Food allowance: capped at ₹300 per person (excluding taxes), per bill. Anything beyond this will need additional approval before the payment is made.
🧾
Local purchases above ₹1,000 need a written email confirmation from your reporting manager.

Key points to note:

  • Only one reimbursement form per employee, per month will be accepted.
  • All claims must be submitted by the 5th of the following month.
  • Approved reimbursements will be processed along with the monthly salary.
  • Bills/receipts are mandatory for all claims — attach one against each item below.
  • Please ensure the format and guidelines are followed strictly.
  • Non-compliant submissions may be delayed or rejected.

📵 Submitting a reimbursement claim is only available on desktop — please open the Hub on a computer to fill out and submit the form. The rules above still apply here on mobile.
